snippet.title: No Elevator | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
No Elevator! 
No Safety Net. Just the Climb.

Your claustrophobia means the elevator is out of the question. Home is at the very top of this skyscraper, and the only way there is up the outside wall. Armed with a plank gun and limited resources, you have to build your own path while dodging flying junk, hostile drones, and aggressive wildlife.
One wrong shot and you're stuck. One wrong step and you fall.

Wishlist on Steam today! (And yes, you can pet the cats on the ledges).
